verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a cron or scheduled-job capability for running recurring jobs or workflows. Vercel Workflows is described as durable multi-step code with retries, event waits, and crash resumption, but nothing says it runs on a recurring schedule. The only schedule-related item is static page regeneration on a schedule (ISR), which is an adjacent caching feature, not general job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
